mbm-2301.clue: The zipper pull sits where a button ought to be.
mbm-2301.quote: Gran couldn't work coat buttons with her gloves on. I stitched a zipper behind them and hung a red tassel on the pull. She zipped up, shoved both hands in the snow and challenged me to a rematch.

mbm-2302.clue: That blue flannel sleeve has seen every episode.
mbm-2302.quote: My sister and I watch space reruns in our pajamas. During commercials our cuffs become puppets and we act out what ought to happen. Our alien captain has a terrible plaid complexion.

mbm-2303.clue: I didn't go anywhere on my longest train journey.
mbm-2303.quote: The station clock was being repaired, so I sketched each train as it stopped. I folded the pages into one long accordion. Open it and a whole afternoon goes by.

mbm-2304.clue: I still owe the librarian a grocery bag.
mbm-2304.quote: I borrowed so many adventure books that my bike basket broke. The librarian lent me an orange string bag. I take it back every Saturday full of books and come home the same way.

mbm-2305.clue: The lucky disc has a patch of green paint.
mbm-2305.quote: I threw a frisbee through some fresh fence paint. My sister said the smudge looked like a fish. Now each time I let it fly, my little green fish gets a turn in the sky.

mbm-2306.clue: My lemonade gets its own cabana.
mbm-2306.quote: I tie a little paper awning over our lemon jug. Dad and I hardly move from our towels, but we shift that tiny awning all afternoon as though the jug were royalty.

mbm-2307.clue: We knock twice when the baby's asleep.
mbm-2307.quote: The domino table used to shake my niece awake. I stretched an old green sweater over it. Our games are nearly silent now, except when someone wins and all four of us whisper at once.

mbm-2308.clue: I keep my first spare in a jam jar.
mbm-2308.quote: The night I made my first bowling spare, the lane printer spat out blank paper. My sister drew the pins on it herself. I rolled it up and put it beside the shoe polish.

mbm-2309.clue: We have been rehearsing the same chorus for months.
mbm-2309.quote: After my last lap the lifeguard lends me his whistle. I try to play our team's song with water in my ears and half the pool watching. Nobody has recognized the tune yet.

mbm-2310.clue: The teapot has nicer earmuffs than I do.
mbm-2310.quote: I measured my first crochet hat on our teapot and forgot to leave room for ears. Mum claimed it as a tea cosy. I added a flap for the spout and it hasn't missed breakfast since.

mbm-2311.clue: One yellow ribbon means there's a place for you.
mbm-2311.quote: At folk dance I tie a yellow ribbon to the spare chair. My first week I sat there counting steps. Last week someone else took it and I was the one holding out a hand.

mbm-2312.clue: My goggles ride home on a passenger.
mbm-2312.quote: I rescued a plastic duck from the pool filter when I was nine. Every time I finish a long set I put my goggles on the duck and let it look accomplished.

mbm-2313.quote: My husband drew two pairs of feet on the garage floor for our first ballroom lessons. All that's left is one chalk heel. When my sister visits we start there too, even when the car is parked crooked.

mbm-2314.clue: I got two sunsets for the price of one.
mbm-2314.quote: Our plane climbed into the light just after the field went dark. When my parachute opened the sun was still sitting on the horizon. I tucked that second sunset into my logbook in orange pencil.

mbm-2315.clue: My radio desk has a very small mailbox.
mbm-2315.quote: I made a tin mailbox for the cards our ham station gets. The one from an island arrived salt-stained on one corner. I still pretend the card swam here.

mbm-2316.clue: I never rush the bowl after the bath.
mbm-2316.quote: After a soak I sit by the window with shaved ice. Last winter the snow made the same little mountain on the sill, so I gave them matching red cherries.

mbm-2317.clue: My dog wears a piece of our first apartment.
mbm-2317.quote: I cut his collar from a leather chair we couldn't fit through the van door. I kept the scratch he made as a puppy. He wears it over his right shoulder.

mbm-2318.clue: I wear the wrong pajamas for the right ending.
mbm-2318.quote: For mystery reruns we vote with our pajamas. Stripes mean the butler did it. Last Friday four people in stripes made cocoa for one very smug person in polka dots.

mbm-2319.clue: My oldest belt keeps a door open.
mbm-2319.quote: When our karate club moved upstairs we needed something soft to hold the studio door. I tied my old white belt to the handle. It's held the door for every new kid since.

mbm-2320.quote: Dad kept mixing up his ski edges. At breakfast I showed him the whole turn with two strips of toast. We ran out of jam long before we ran out of slope.

mbm-2321.clue: I came for a rare bird and left with a familiar one.
mbm-2321.quote: I waited in the reeds for a heron. A robin landed on my binocular strap and watched with me. My notebook has two pages about that robin.

mbm-2322.clue: There's a spare sunrise hanging in my bathroom.
mbm-2322.quote: I printed one photograph too dark and pegged it across a brighter print to dry. The two horizons lined up like a double sunrise. I let them stay till Monday.
